author: Myv
body:
Hi, _Za here.

Now that the alert icon is here (the red exclamation mark next to teams whenever you have a notification), I have a suggestion that can add to it.

With social networking sites such as Facebook or Instagram, if your username gets tagged, it will appear on your notifications. 

Could it be possible if we could do this in Avicus?

Example

123: How can this work?

456: @123 by doing this.

By using @ before the username, this can alert the player in the notifications section.

Opinions on this?

_Za
